name: Anekawa Shigure
source:
The only daughter of famous newscaster Anekawa Kiriko. Extremely popular in her academy with many juniors looking up to her. She complains about the store's lineup whenever she patronises it. 

[Spoiler] The illegitimate offspring of Anekawa Kiriko and the academy headmaster (Isshiki Yuki's father), her mother never told her about the father's true identity. Although her mother makes a living reporting on scandals to expose them to the court of public justice, she resents the fact that her mother is really a hypocrite and makes a living out of ruining the lives of others. [/Spoiler]
